description: This file contains a static utility class 'AssetParentPseudoValidation' providing validation methods for the 'Parent Pseudo Asset' relationships within an asset management system. It primarily implements a method to asynchronously validate asset linkage rules based on specific business logic, including existence checks, self-reference elimination, and cycle detection in parent hierarchy.

classes.name: AssetParentPseudoValidation
classes.description: A static class providing validation utilities specifically for the parent pseudo asset relationships, ensuring integrity and adherence to hierarchy rules.

methods.name: ValidateAndThrowAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously validates the parent pseudo asset conditions, including existence, self-reference, and cycle detection, throwing a RequestValidationException if validation fails.
